NONE: ไม่มีอาหารในภาพ

The prawns are whole and raw, translucent grey-blue, the pot holds only clear water.
WATER: หม้อน้ำเปล่า
The pot holds only clear water, no prawns or any food in frame.
RAW_BOARD: กุ้งดิบบนเขียง
The prawns are whole and raw, translucent grey-blue, nothing cooked.
PEELING: กำลังแกะกุ้งดิบ
Raw prawns being peeled, translucent grey flesh, heads with orange tomalley set aside, nothing cooked yet.
PEELED: กุ้งแกะแล้ว ยังดิบ
Peeled raw prawn tails in an enamel bowl, heads in another bowl, nothing cooked yet.
GARLIC: เจียวกระเทียมในหม้อ กุ้งยังดิบ
Chopped garlic frying golden in oil in the pot, prawn heads and tails still raw in side bowls.

Pale chopped garlic just starting to sizzle in hot oil in the pot, not golden yet, no prawns in the pot.

Golden garlic oil in the pot with only a few fried garlic bits left, the fried garlic set aside in a small bowl, prawn heads and tails still raw in side bowls.
HEADS: ผัดหัวกุ้งในน้ำมันกระเทียม
Prawn heads frying in garlic oil in the pot, shells turning bright orange, peeled tails still raw in a side bowl.

Pale orange-tinted broth simmering with prawn heads, no rice yet, peeled tails still raw in a side bowl.
BROTH: น้ำซุปใส่ข้าวแล้ว กุ้งยังดิบ
Golden broth with soft jasmine rice grains simmering, orange prawn oil on the surface, peeled tails still raw in a side bowl.

Peeled prawns just dropped into the simmering rice broth, still translucent grey, starting to curl.
COOKED: กุ้งสุกในหม้อ
The prawns are fully cooked, curled, opaque white flesh with bright orange-red stripes, in the rice broth.

Finished prawn rice soup in the rooster bowl: rice in golden broth, cooked orange-striped prawns, fried garlic, ginger strips, cilantro, spring onion, white pepper.
